baseline.implementation: OIA-1 v0.2.1 plus frozen Track A 006b runner

claim_boundary: Controlled deterministic Track A diagnostic of a frozen resettable sequential fusion. No external validation, learned ontology formation, necessary revision, semantic novelty, sealed transfer, population inference, comparative superiority, real ARC intervention, or Track B claim.

development.data_status: completed and fully opened Track A 006b outcome
development.role: composition-rule development only; no 006c outcome evidence

execution.reset_contract: After a closed candidate result, restore the same target exactly to its initial state before reject-aware confirmation. Record one reset marker and reset_count=1; do not include reset in intervention step totals.
sequential_fusion: closed outside_model -> outside_detected_closed and stop without reset
otherwise reset once and execute reject_aware_native
two candidate identities agree -> identify that candidate
execution.target_information: Neither component policy receives target transitions, hash, kind, seed, or future observations. Fusion receives only the two frozen component terminal records.

generation.inheritance: Exact Track A 006b base, sentinel, outside-target, behavioral-distinctness, depth-filter, cap, attempt, and rejection rules under a new master seed.
generation.namespace_separation: base, sentinel, and outside generation stages are SHA-256 framed; fixture and held-out master seeds are distinct.

primary: sequential-fusion outside detection and false candidate identification counts
sequential-fusion intervention steps and separately counted resets
outcomes.required_soundness: All three methods must correctly identify all 256 in-family targets. Any incorrect identification or outside decision is an instrument blocker.
secondary: standalone closed and reject-aware outside outcomes
fusion detection breakdown by closed novelty, reject-aware novelty, and identity disagreement
paired component-to-fusion transitions, policy depths, attempts, rejections, hashes, and exact traces
outcomes.statistics: Exact deterministic paired corpus counts only; no p-values, confidence intervals, population generalization, or superiority claim.

prospective_ordering: fusion rule fixed using only opened 006b traces
held-out seed, inherited generation, reset contract, fusion, endpoints, stop rules, and evidence format frozen
freeze merged before held-out case generation
future single held-out execution and immutable outcome packaging
stop_rules: Stop on any inherited 006b generation, cap, or exactness blocker.
Stop with an instrument blocker if any method incorrectly identifies or rejects an in-family target.
Stop with an applicability blocker if reset does not restore the exact initial target state.
Do not change seeds, inherited generator, policies, fusion, reset accounting, endpoints, or evidence format after held-out execution; defects require a new numbered slice.
